spans.text: This application is in compliance with the Federal Information Security Management Act of 2014 (FISMA), USDA Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) Directives, and U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Special Publication 800-53, Revision 4 guidance: · Access Control (AC) o Awareness and Training (AT) o Audit and Accountability (AU) o Security Assessment and Authorization (CA) o Configuration Management (CM) o Contingency Planning (CP) o Identification and Authentication (IA) o Incident Response (IR) o Maintenance (MA) o Media Protection (MP) o Physical and Environmental Protection (PE) o Planning (PL) o Personnel Security (PS) o Risk Assessment (RA) o System and Services Acquisition (SA) o System and Communication Protection (SC) o System and Information Integrity (SI) NIST 800-53, Appendix J, Revision 4 controls include: · Authority and Purpose (AP) o Accountability, Audit, and Risk management (AR) o Data Quality and Integrity (DI) o Data Minimization and Retention (DM) o Individual Participation and Redress (IP) o Security (SE) o Transparency (TR) o Use Limitation (UL) If any residual risks are identified, they will be managed and reported via the FISMA mandated risk assessment processes.
spans.section: 2.4 Privacy Impact Analysis: Describe any types of controls that may be in place to ensure that information is handled in accordance with the above described uses.
spans.explanation: States that identified residual risks will be managed and reported through mandated risk-assessment processes.
